svg.metadata: HISTROVE-CRYPTO-PRINT-v1.0. Approved by Dan Payne 6 October 2026. Exact v1.2 framing, art, typography and QR preserved; approved top-right HISTROVE crown/wordmark replaces LORE. 816x1110 at 300 DPI. Physical printer/sample acceptance pending. Raster illustration and brush wordmark; vector frame, crown, outlined text and QR.
